", "explanation": "Adds the imports needed for the Field(union_mode=...) annotation on Metric.value. Annotated and Field are used by the value fix below; BaseModel is still used."}, {"finding_ids": ["app/metrics.py:14:deprecated-method"], "search": "    value: Union[int, str]
", "replace": "    value: Annotated[Union[int, str], Field(union_mode='left_to_right')]
", "explanation": "Pydantic v2 defaults Union to 'smart' mode, which keeps an exact str input like '42' as a str because it matches the str member exactly. Pydantic v1 tried union members left to right, so '42' was coerced to int 42. union_mode='left_to_right' (Field option in pydantic v2) restores the v1 behavior so numeric strings become ints and 'n/a' stays a str, making numeric_total return 100. The Metric.model_validate call is unchanged."}], "notes": "The failing test was caused by the Union[int, str] field. In pydantic v2 smart mode, the string '42' matches str exactly and stays a string, so numeric_total filtered it out and returned 0. v1 tried union members left to right and coerced '42' to 42. The fix sets union_mode='left_to_right' on the field to match v1 behavior. The previous migration (parse_obj -> model_validate) is kept. The finding id is reused because the same line is involved in the failure. The edits do not overlap: the first edit changes only the import lines and the second changes only the value field line."}
